description: This file defines the interface (function declarations) for managing USP (User Services Platform) record connections, including WebSocket, MQTT, STOMP, and UDS protocols. It also includes a disconnect function with parameters for content type, endpoint ID, reason code, and reason string.

methods.name: USPREC_WebSocketConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection with the given endpoint ID and message item.

methods.name: USPREC_MqttConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates an MQTT connection with specified endpoint ID, MQTT version, agent topic, and message item.

methods.name: USPREC_StompConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a STOMP connection with the specified endpoint ID, destination, and message item.

methods.name: USPREC_UdsConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a UDS connection with the specified endpoint ID and message item.

methods.name: USPREC_Disconnect_Create
methods.description: Initiates a disconnect with the specified content type, endpoint ID, reason code, and reason string.
